SaaS & Multi-Tenant Platforms

SaaS & Multi-Tenant Platforms

We design SaaS platforms where each customer (tenant) operates isolated and secure on a single codebase. From the data model to billing, we design the platform so growth doesn't mean rewriting.

Arquitectura multi-tenant

Aislamiento por organización, autenticación única (SSO) y datos separados. Diseñamos el modelo que mejor encaja con tu producto.

Presentación

Web apps y APIs por tenant con aislamiento real.

Datos

Bases por inquilino o sharding por región según tu modelo.

Escala

Autoescalado horizontal en picos de demanda sin downtime.

What we solve[02.00]

What we solve

02.1

One deployment per customer

Every new customer means more infrastructure, more cost and more risk.

02.2

Data without isolation

The risk of one tenant seeing another's data is unacceptable.

02.3

Manual provisioning

Onboarding a customer takes days and depends on one person.

02.4

Repeated authentication

Users forced to log in to each instance separately.

How we do it[02.0]

How we do it

02.1

Isolation by design

Row-Level Security and per-organization scopes: isolation enforced by the database.

02.2

Single sign-on (SSO)

OIDC with a central IdP: sign in once and access your instances without re-authenticating.

02.3

Automated provisioning

Tenant onboarding in minutes, not days, with per-organization configuration.

02.4

One codebase

All customers on the same version: fewer bugs, more speed.

When it applies[02.00]

When it applies

B2B SaaS with multiple organizations
Platforms with per-customer instances
Products requiring data isolation
Ecosystems with portal and marketplace
